payload.intro: You call that a combat level, maggot? How high does it even go?
payload.prompt: What is the highest combat level?
payload.explanation: Every player starts at combat level 3 and tops out at 126.

payload.intro: Before a boss fight you knock its Defence down first! With what, maggot?
payload.prompt: Which weapon's special attack lowers the target's Defence by 30%?
payload.explanation: The dragon warhammer's Smash hits 50% harder and lowers Defence by 30%, but only on a hit that deals damage.

payload.intro: Every maggot wants a twisted bow. Do you even know where to get one?
payload.prompt: Which raid drops the twisted bow?
payload.explanation: The twisted bow is a rare reward from the Chambers of Xeric, and needs 85 Ranged to wield.

payload.intro: There's a triangle to fighting, maggot, and you'd better know which corner wins!
payload.prompt: In the combat triangle, which style is strong against Ranged?
payload.explanation: Melee beats Ranged, Ranged beats Magic and Magic beats Melee.

payload.intro: Want a fire cape, maggot? Then you'd better know how many waves stand in your way!
payload.prompt: How many waves does the TzHaar Fight Cave have?
payload.explanation: The Fight Cave has 63 waves, and TzTok-Jad waits at the last one.

payload.intro: Six brothers lie in the barrows of Morytania, maggot. Pick them out of this line-up!
payload.prompt: Which of these are Barrows brothers?
payload.explanation: The six are Ahrim, Dharok, Guthan, Karil, Torag and Verac. K'ril Tsutsaroth leads Zamorak's army in the God Wars Dungeon, Vorkath is a dragon and torstol is a herb.

payload.intro: We may have chosen wildly different professions, but we are still kin.
payload.prompt: What will the demon butler serve when you ask him to make dinner?
payload.explanation: The other foods are served by the meek lower-level servants.

payload.prompt: Which defenders have a lower melee strength bonus than the mooleta?
payload.explanation: The mooleta has a melee strength bonus of just 1, tied with the steel defender. The bronze and iron defenders offer no melee strength bonus. Every other defender outclasses the mooleta.

payload.intro: Speed kills, maggot! Line these weapons up from the fastest strikes to the slowest heavy swings!
payload.prompt: Order these weapons by their attack speed, from fastest (fewest ticks) to slowest (most ticks).
payload.explanation: Darts on rapid fire every 2 ticks, the ham joint every 3 ticks, whips every 4 ticks, Osmumten's fang every 5 ticks and Dharok's greataxe every 7 ticks.

payload.intro: Each of the six Barrows brothers takes a different weapon to his grave, maggot! Name their arms!
payload.prompt: Match each Barrows brother to the weapon he wields.
payload.explanation: Dharok wields a greataxe, Guthan a warspear, Verac a flail, Torag twin hammers, Karil a repeating crossbow and Ahrim a quarterstaff.

payload.intro: Watch that special attack bar, maggot! Sort these weapons by how much special attack energy one strike drains!
payload.prompt: Sort these weapons by the special attack energy percentage they consume per use.
payload.explanation: Dragon dagger and Osmumten's fang use 25% special attack energy; dragon claws and Bandos godsword use 50%; dragon battleaxe and Excalibur consume 100%.

payload.intro: You survived 63 waves in the Fight Cave? Cute! Now jump into the lava and face TzKal-Zuk!
payload.prompt: How many waves are there in the Inferno?
payload.explanation: The Inferno has 69 waves, ending with triple Jads on wave 68 and TzKal-Zuk on wave 69.

payload.intro: The Chambers of Xeric has the twisted bow, and the Theatre of Blood has the scythe of vitur. What's the third raid's big prize, maggot?
payload.prompt: Which two-handed powered staff is the mega-rare reward from the Tombs of Amascut?
payload.explanation: Tumeken's shadow is the mega-rare reward from the Tombs of Amascut, multiplying your magic accuracy and damage.
